title: 我的一天

explanations.1: 了 indicates the completion of the action 'get up'.
explanations.2: 一 is the numeral used before the measure word 杯.
explanations.3: 杯 is the measure word for cups of liquid.
explanations.4: 两 is the numeral for two before the measure word 块.
explanations.5: 块 is the measure word for pieces of bread.
explanations.6: 八 is the number for the hour eight o'clock.
explanations.7: 点 indicates the hour of the time.
explanations.8: 里 shows location inside the school.
explanations.10: 很 is an adverb modifying 多 to mean 'very many'.
explanations.11: 多 describes the quantity of students.
explanations.12: 正在 indicates an ongoing action.
explanations.13: 上 is the verb for attending a class.
explanations.15: 教 is the verb 'teach', the teacher's action.
explanations.16: 都 emphasizes that everyone loves the teacher.
explanations.20: 从 indicates the starting point 'from school'.

translation: I got up at seven in the morning, drank a cup of milk, and ate two pieces of bread. At eight I went to school. There are many students inside the school. We are having Chinese class. The teacher teaches us Chinese characters. We all love the teacher. I can write Chinese characters, and I can also speak a little Chinese. At noon I eat lunch with my classmate together at the school restaurant. The lunch is very delicious. In the afternoon we have Chinese characters class. After class I go home from school. In the evening I do homework and watch TV. Don't watch TV too late; go to sleep at ten.
